description: A retrospective that only discusses; nobody takes on a task. Invented people and facts.
lines: Let's just talk through how the conference went, no decisions needed today.
I thought the booth was busier on the second day than the first.
Agreed. The demo on the big screen pulled people in much better than the posters.
The coffee queue next to us helped too, honestly.
People asked a lot about offline mode, more than about pricing.
That matches what I heard. Mostly teachers and small clinics.
Okay, good to share. Nothing to follow up on, we'll talk again next month.
